'''''Fate of the Jedi: Backlash''''', by [[Aaron Allston]], is the fourth novel in the [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series and was released on [[March 9]], [[2010]]. At the end of the book, it has an introduction to ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Allies]]''. The audio version is narrated by [[Marc Thompson]]. The paperback was released on [[February 22]], [[2011]].
